title: EventStream
description: An owner-namespaced durable event stream and its typed event projection. The family mints NO sequence, admission decision, receipt, state root, receipt root, or transition chain: every chain-bearing value is a REFERENCE to the canonical Agentgres operation that admitted it (ADR 0030). Event kinds are typed by owner-declared payload schema refs scoped to the stream owner namespace; there is no closed global event-kind enum and no consumer vocabulary (GoalRun, thread, room, or otherwise) is an admission-required field. Each owner namespace declares which of its event classes are admitted truth and which are ephemeral delivery-only: an occurrence is admitted truth iff it changes durable state, authority, or obligation, is required for replay, or bars/enables a claim; samples of a changing value (token deltas, presence, cursor position, progress, per-line logs) are ephemeral. The structural bar, not the numeric one, is decisive: an ephemeral delivery awaits no Agentgres operation.

owner_namespace.description: The declaring owner's namespace. The substrate branches on no namespace value; it is an identity, never a switch.

owner_ref.description: The canonical owner object this stream belongs to, in that owner's own vocabulary. Opaque to the substrate.

event_class_declaration.description: Per-owner-namespace classification. Declared by the owner, enforced by the substrate: an admitted class crosses an atomic Agentgres transition; an ephemeral class mints nothing and awaits no Agentgres operation.

admitted_truth_classes.description: Occurrence classes that change durable state, authority, or obligation, are required for replay, or bar/enable a claim.

ephemeral_delivery_classes.description: Delivery-only classes: samples of a changing value. A heartbeat is ephemeral; the lapse transition it feeds is admitted truth.

latency_budget_ref.description: Reference to the canon-owned latency budget profile this stream's ephemeral path must meet (initial ratified values: p95 <= 150ms local ephemeral delivery, p95 <= 1000ms admitted-append acknowledgment). Referenced, never hardcoded, so the canon owner can tune without reopening this contract.

admitted_head.description: The stream's current admitted position, entirely by reference to the canonical Agentgres operation. The family owns no head scalar of its own.

genesis_operation_ref.description: Reference to the Agentgres operation that admitted this stream's first event, when one exists.

retention_policy_ref.description: Owner-declared retention policy reference; retention is policy, never a truth mutation.

class_id.description: Owner-scoped class identity. Deliberately not a closed global enum: the substrate never enumerates consumer event kinds.

payload_schema_ref.description: The owner-declared payload schema for this class. Typing lives with the owner; the substrate validates the reference, not the vocabulary.

classification_basis.description: Why this class falls on its side of the admitted/ephemeral line, in the owner's words.

agentgresOperationReference.description: A reference to canonical Agentgres truth. Every chain-bearing value here is a ref string produced by the substrate's backed constructors; the family owns no sequence, root, head, or receipt scalar. Fabricated agentgres:// strings are not grandfathered.
